Manifest.Name: 开箱时刻 / Unbox Moment
Manifest.Author: 小行星
Manifest.Description: 为物资箱加入开箱动画。物品逐件揭晓，声光效果随价值变化，最后汇总数量与总价值。推荐安装“游戏内模组设置 / In-Game Mod Settings”（asteroid_in_game_mod_settings），以便在游戏中的原生选项页直接调整本模组。独立的设置模组为可选软依赖：未安装时开箱功能正常运行。 An opening animation for supply crates, with item reveals, effects that vary by value, and a summary of your haul. Recommended companion: In-Game Mod Settings (asteroid_in_game_mod_settings), which adds access to this mod's settings from the native in-game options screen. This companion is an optional soft dependency.
